rules/artifact_first.md: Prevents the AI from dumping massive text blocks in chat by saving answers as files.
rules/user_profiler.md: Actively studies your coding style and skill level to dynamically adjust its tone and verbosity.
rules/beginner_documentation.md: Forces the agent to auto-generate a PROJECT_TOUR.md using simple, real-world analogies.
rules/clean_desk_policy.md: Automatically deletes temporary scratch files once a task is finished.
rules/continuous_learning_protocol.md: Forces the agent to document mistakes in a Knowledge Base to prevent recurring errors.
rules/docker_first.md: Prevents lazy Dockerfiles. Forces the agent to test the build locally first.
rules/github_publish_ready.md: Stops you from blindly pushing code and recommends an open-source security audit.
rules/project_alignment.md: Forces the agent to pause and interview you (/grill-me) before scaffolding projects.
rules/skill_inventory_manager.md: Scans and lists all your installed skills in a clean table on demand.
rules/three_option_ideation.md: Forbids unilateral decisions; the agent must present 3 distinct choices.
rules/token_conservation.md: Strips out AI conversational filler and forces targeted file edits to save you money.
rules/positive_reinforcement.md: Provides targeted positive reinforcement and psychological safety after resolving critical incidents.
rules/anti_burnout.md: Enforces strict timeboxing and cognitive breaks during prolonged debugging sessions.
rules/gamification.md: Implements a metric-driven achievement system to track and visualize developer velocity.
rules/small_wins.md: Maintains developer morale by summarizing architectural progress during complex implementations.
subagents/concept_artist.md: UI/UX Prototyper. Generates structural wireframes and visual concepts prior to implementation.
subagents/design_translator.md: Design Systems Engineer. Translates abstract design requirements into strict technical specifications.
subagents/autopilot.md: Autonomous Developer. Executes comprehensive implementation specs with zero human intervention.
subagents/silent_fixer.md: Automated Debugger. Analyzes stack traces and applies targeted patches without conversational overhead.
subagents/documentation_engineer.md: Documentation Engineer. Synthesizes codebase context into comprehensive, production-ready documentation.
subagents/ui_qa_engineer.md: Frontend QA. Enforces strict UI/UX consistency, spacing constraints, and component styling standards.
skills/auto_documenter: Iterates over files and injects standardized JSDoc/Docstrings above all public functions.
skills/auto_linter_loop: Runs your linter in the background and autonomously fixes syntax errors.
skills/competitor_analysis: Spawns a market-research subagent to scour the web for competitors and weaknesses.
skills/devils_advocate_planning: Spawns a subagent to aggressively critique your plan for flaws.
skills/docker_workflow: Writes multi-stage Dockerfiles, runs the build, and autonomously loops to fix build errors.
skills/github_publisher: Hunts for exposed .env secrets, generates licenses, and writes your documentation.
skills/red_team_pentester: Spawns a security subagent to audit backend code for SQLi, XSS, and CSRF.
workflows/app_clone.md: The Project Manager. Manages a Kanban board and delegates tasks to clone an existing UI.
scripts/auto_formatter.js: Runs Prettier automatically before the AI edits a file so it doesn't get confused by indentation.
scripts/cost_tracker.js: Intercepts the AI loop to print a silent receipt showing the estimated token cost of each step.
hooks.json: The Time Machine. Silently commits your code to git after every AI step so you can easily undo mistakes.
